description: Patterns excluded from public publication of the olam plugin. Used by scripts/scrub-check.mjs. Entries support an optional 'flags' field (e.g. 'gi' for case-insensitive matching of brand variants).

patterns.rationale: Atlas is the internal/private fork; the public olam brand should not reference it. Case-insensitive to catch ATLAS KITCHEN / Atlas-kitchen variants.

Bare 'atlas' (case-insensitive, word-boundary) — catches Atlas / ATLAS / atlas-toolbox / atlas-builders / atlas-specific / etc. in body content. The /atl:* skill identifiers (slash-prefix) are NOT word-boundary matches and remain unflagged. Self-referential scrub-tooling files + the audit doc that names this rule are allowlisted explicitly.

Prophylactic bare-Grain rule (case-insensitive, word-boundary). Grain is one of the orgs onboarding to olam; the olam-cli plugin is the public-publish surface and should not name specific adopting orgs in body content.
Kebab-case variant of the internal brand.
Alternative spelling of the internal domain.
Slack/email handle alias for internal contacts.
Linear ticket prefix used for not-for-public-disclosure issues.
AWS account IDs are sensitive and should never appear in plugin docs.
Private Slack channels should not be referenced in plugin docs (use public channels for support pointers).
Generic 'corp.<company>.<tld>' subdomain pattern indicates an internal-only resource.
EC2 instance / EBS volume / security group / subnet IDs (private infrastructure identifiers).
Personal internal-domain email (use public contact paths in plugin docs instead).
